citations.claim: First pole_upright violation: theta -0.8527 exceeds 0.8 limit, cart at x 0.514 with high velocity and spin
One step before failure pole already at -0.619 and diverging with omega -11.7
System energy ballooned to 32.16 by step 34 vs 1.04 initial, showing unstable feedback

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.0145 to 0.0, keeping all else identical; failure disappears, implicating noisy feedback at large dt as cause.

explanation: Shrunk scenario starts balanced (theta 0) but with seeded sensor noise 0.0145 and large dt 0.0194. Controller acts on noisy angle/rate once per coarse step, injecting erroneous forces (e.g., 16.3 at step 20 when theta 0.47). This excites oscillation that grows: by step 30 theta -0.03 but omega -8.1 and v 5.5, by step 33 theta -0.619 omega -11.7, by step 34 theta -0.853 violating 0.8 limit. Zeroing noise alone removes failure, confirming noise-driven destabilization at large dt, not initial condition or pushes (none).
vision_note: The pole is near upright at step 31 but leans progressively farther through steps 32 and 33. By step 34 it is tilted sharply to the side and colored red as the violating body.
